amount.description: The total amount available on the card. In minor units. The number of decimals are controlled by the currency.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code states which currency it is and how many decimals the amount has.

iv.description: Initialization vector for symmetric decryption with the AES key.

aes_key.description: The symmetric key complying the Advanced Encryption Standard.

holder.description: Card holder name on the card.
